summary_1line: Sakuntala recounts how Indra sent the apsara Menaka to seduce the ascetic Viswamitra, leading to Sakuntala’s birth and abandonment by the Malini river.

image_candidates.scene_text: Menaka dances before the meditating sage Viswamitra as the wind god steals her moon‑white garments in the forest hermitage.
Viswamitra, blazing with ascetic power, opens his eyes to behold the radiant apsara Menaka standing unveiled before him.
A newborn Sakuntala lies on the lonely bank of the Malini river while protective vultures circle and guard the infant in the wild forest.
